items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: John Hammond. Red was scuffling and split with Mildred, he had gone off on his own and I guess Benny needed somebody at that point, so they offered and I made a decision and I went.

ctx.x: It's a hidden authority; it's a weird thing.
We have to get back to Benny. We've been jumping around but never really nailing him squarely. How did this offer to come and work for Benny come about?

John Hammond. Red was scuffling and split with Mildred, he had gone off on his own and I guess Benny needed somebody at that point, so they offered and I made a decision and I went. I always felt like I was leaving home, it
